and reg.Org_Code like CONCAT('%',#{noworg},'%')
AND (plan_id=4 OR plan_id=7) AND plandetail_id is not null AND rest.plan_startdate BETWEEN #{bigantime} AND #{endtime}
GROUP BY rest.user_code ) a
